stance: Housing is weak at a low level. Existing sales fell 5.5% to 3.75M SAAR in the last print, with mortgage rates near 7.4%. October starts rebounded 9.9% to 1,309k after a revised 1,191k, but permits fell 7.4% to 1,295k, below the 1,350k warning level. Permits lead starts, so the starts bounce is likely to fade. Residential investment stays a GDP drag. New home sales falling below 676k would confirm deterioration. View is provisional.
